title.zh: 将卡林加省 Tabuk 市镇 Bado Dangwa 描笼涯的 Tuga 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Bado Dangwa 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Tuga National High School - Bado Dangwa Annex in Barangay Bado Dangwa, Municipality of Tabuk, Province of Kalinga From the Tuga National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to be Known as Bado Dangwa National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Tuga National High School - Bado Dangwa Annex in Barangay Bado Dangwa, Municipality of Tabuk, Province of Kalinga From the Tuga National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to be Known as Bado Dangwa National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Bado Dangwa của Trường Trung học Tuga Quốc gia tại Barangay Bado Dangwa, Đô thị Tabuk, Tỉnh Kalinga khỏi Trường Trung học Tuga Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Bado Dangwa Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Bado Dangwa ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tuga แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Bado Dangwa เทศบาล Tabuk จังหวัด Kalinga ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tuga แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bado Dangwa แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Bado Dangwa, Sekolah Menengah Tuga Nasional di Barangay Bado Dangwa, Kotamadya Tabuk, Provinsi Kalinga dari Sekolah Menengah Tuga Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bado Dangwa Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Bado Dangwa, Sekolah Menengah Tuga Kebangsaan di Barangay Bado Dangwa, Perbandaran Tabuk, Wilayah Kalinga daripada Sekolah Menengah Tuga Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bado Dangwa Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Tuga National High School – Bado Dangwa Annex in Barangay Bado Dangwa, Municipality of Tabuk, Province of Kalinga is hereby separated from the Tuga National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Bado Dangwa National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Tuga National High School – Bado Dangwa Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Bado Dangwa National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Bado Dangwa National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Tuga National High School – Bado Dangwa Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
